Bookmark.title: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A user's synced browser bookmark stored in Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: The authenticated user's UID owning this bookmark.

title.description: The display title of the bookmarked webpage.

url.description: The full URL of the bookmarked webpage.

folder.description: The bookmark folder or category name.

faviconUrl.description: The resolved favicon URL for the website.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Shortcut.title: Shortcut
Shortcut.description: A speed-dial website shortcut saved to the user's browser homepage.

userId.description: The authenticated user's UID owning this homepage shortcut.

name.description: The display name of the shortcut.

logoUrl.description: The automatically resolved website logo/favicon URL.

isPinned.description: Whether the shortcut is pinned to the top of the speed dial.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shortcut was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shortcut was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/shortcuts/{shortcutId}.description: Stores per-user speed-dial homepage website shortcuts.
